rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: One Tiny Imperfection
card.instruction: Choose one tiny imperfection and let it steadily outweigh every larger concern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we cut our wedding cake, that cherry's stem needs straightening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already called everyone over. Two hundred people are standing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they'll see the top clearly. Turn the stand towards me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our photographer leaves in two minutes. Please get beside me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask her for a close-up of the stem first. We can have our portrait taken on someone's phone.

card.title: One Tiny Imperfection
card.instruction: Choose one tiny imperfection and let it steadily outweigh every larger concern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we hand over the house keys, can we straighten that hallway frame?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The buyers are waiting. Our taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They're standing right under it. They'll think we left it like that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They just hung it. It's theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give them the keys. I'll stay and show them how to look after the frame.

transfer.action: I straighten one tiny imperfection on {prop} again.
transfer.opening: I can't concentrate while that leans. {request}
transfer.response: The beautiful parts aren't correcting this corner. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You're the only one who sees it.
transfer.closing: Then I'm carrying the entire room's share of noticing.
